coder_notes: Mixed population: GBM IDH-wildtype or WHO grade 3 IDH-mutant astrocytoma (CDKN2A/B intact). IDH and CDKN2A/B rows reflect diagnostic entry requirements (IDH-wildtype defines GBM; IDH-mutant/CDKN2A/B intact define the grade 3 astrocytoma population), applying to population subgroups rather than registered arms; neither is linked to eflornithine. PK outcomes (Cmax, AUC etc.) do not state sample type, but the only stated matrix is plasma concentration of eflornithine; coded tumour_pk_planned no. All arms are dose-escalation experimental arms (no control). Temozolomide given at approved maintenance dose as backbone; for astrocytoma patients it continues adjuvant TMZ.
